title.value: Build an email signup landing page on Carrd

introduction.value: Operator built a Carrd landing page for a fictional restaurant email marketing platform, picking a template and editing text and images; the author had to step in for the pro login and some customization.

method.value: The author used ChatGPT Operator, which works in a virtual browser, and asked it to build an email-collection page for a fictional restaurant email marketing platform. It went to Carrd, chose a free template, and changed the title and text. When adding a form needed a premium plan, the author logged in to their pro account. Operator then carried on uploading images and making edits.

outcome.value: The page came out incomplete. Operator struggled with some customization, had trouble removing unneeded sections, left some sections without proper copy, and needed frequent human help.

notes.value: Operator is part of the ChatGPT Pro plan, which cost $200 a month when the article was written. Carrd's form feature also needed a paid Pro account.

source_text.body:
Build an email signup landing page on Carrd
Operator built a Carrd landing page for a fictional restaurant email marketing platform, picking a template and editing text and images; the author had to step in for the pro login and some customization.
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
The author used ChatGPT Operator, which works in a virtual browser, and asked it to build an email-collection page for a fictional restaurant email marketing platform. It went to Carrd, chose a free template, and changed the title and text. When adding a form needed a premium plan, the author logged in to their pro account. Operator then carried on uploading images and making edits.
How it went
The page came out incomplete. Operator struggled with some customization, had trouble removing unneeded sections, left some sections without proper copy, and needed frequent human help.
Worth knowing
Operator is part of the ChatGPT Pro plan, which cost $200 a month when the article was written. Carrd's form feature also needed a paid Pro account.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Go to Carrd and build a one-page email signup landing page for [type of business, e.g. a local restaurant] that collects emails for [purpose, e.g. weekly specials]. Pick a suitable template, then edit the headline, body text, images and signup form to match my brand: [brand name, tone, colors]. If you hit a login or paywall, stop and ask me to take over. Finish when the page is ready to preview, and show it to me before publishing anything.
Original source: https://www.nocode.mba/articles/chatgpt-operator-website-review
